field_rules.license_spdx: Use SPDX identifiers only when verified for the exact project/version; otherwise null and set license_status to unknown, mixed, source-available or proprietary.
field_rules.license_scope: Separate project license, bundled component licenses, dependency licenses, documentation license and content/data rights.
field_rules.maintenance_status: Use maintained, limited, experimental, archived or unknown; support with dated upstream evidence.
field_rules.supported_platforms: List operating systems and hardware architectures explicitly; do not infer compatibility from language or source availability.
field_rules.proprietary_components: Record firmware, drivers, codecs, cloud services, app stores and other non-open components when documented.
field_rules.sbom_formats: Record actual published or generated SPDX/CycloneDX artifacts, not assumed support.
field_rules.vulnerability_sources: Prefer OSV and upstream advisories; record scan timestamp and version scope.
field_rules.build_provenance: Record SLSA/in-toto attestations only when verifiable.
field_rules.artifact_signing: Record signing system and verification instructions, not merely the presence of a checksum.

record_schema.current_seed_records: The current 150+ entries are discovery seeds with name, official URL, resource type and editorial note. They are not yet fully enriched records; fields absent from the seed are unknown, not negative.
